sar.narrative: Customer C02910, holder of card C02910-K1, is the subject of this report due to suspicious online transactions totaling $531.39 conducted between 2016-11-18 18:17 and 2016-12-04 11:17. Specifically, three transactions of $224.80 (3468314, 2016-11-18 18:17), $101.70 (3485910, 2016-11-25 12:37), and $204.89 (3512532, 2016-12-04 11:17) were processed from device profile 'SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080' behind an anonymous proxy. This same device profile was used by 28 cards in a 60-day window around the alert, with all 28 behind an anonymous/hidden proxy and flagged as a new device, indicating a common actor across cards such as C01289-K1, C01996-K2, C02975-K1, C03676-K2, C04108-K2, C04274-K1, C05448-K2, and C06031-K2. The activity is suspicious because the case-memory model score was 0.492, four closed cases on cards using this profile were confirmed fraud with an undocumented pattern, and 8 of the 8 most similar closed cases (including CC-2985, CC-2649, CC-3035, and CC-2971) were confirmed fraud. Furthermore, card C02910-K1 had 1 confirmed-fraud case (CC-5256) in the 45 days before the alert, indicating the card may still be compromised. In response to this activity, the bank has executed final actions including creating a case, monitoring connected cards, escalating to an analyst, and awaiting human approval to block the card and file the report.
